# Traigent Onboarding Test Fixtures

25 handicapped agent packages that exercise every band and cap of the
traigent-first-run readiness model. Point the onboarding at cases/NN-slug/ as the
target project; grade the run against that case's expected-assessment.json. Run
each case on all three coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI)
for the full 25 x 3 = 75-run matrix.

Reproducibility: rows generated with seed 1729.

See MANIFEST.csv for the index. Each case directory has its own README.
